title: Slovakian Beef Skewers
description: A twist on traditional Mexican-style beef skewers, incorporating Slovakian flavors.

ingredients.name: Nourishing dark Slovakian honey
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, pure Slovakian honey for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Beef marinade ingredients (Mexican-style)
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper

ingredients.name: Mixed bell peppers
ingredients.notes: Red, yellow, and green bell peppers

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Red onion for a sweet flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the Slovakian honey, beef marinade ingredients, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and mix to coat.
Thread the marinated beef, bell peppers, onion, and cilantro onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve hot with lime wedges on the side.
